1/ In January 2003, the Australian navy boarded a Taiwanese fishing ship found drifting 150 km out to sea: engine dead, rudder locked, fuel and food still aboard, and the whole crew gone.

2/ Days later, someone in Indonesia was still calling out on the missing engineer's phone. The one crewman police traced said the captain and engineer had been killed, but gave no motive. The rest were never found. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_Aim_6
